chunk.content: Kuniran is the goldband goatfish Upeneus moluccensis (Bleeker, 1855), family Mullidae (goatfishes), distinguished by a mid-lateral yellow or gold stripe from the eye to the upper caudal-fin base, white barbels and red caudal-fin bars.
chunk.source_quote: Teleostei (teleosts) > Mulliformes (Goatfishes) > Mullidae (Goatfishes) ... one mid-lateral body stripe yellow or gold from eye to upper caudal-fin base ... white barbels; silvery-rose body
